summary: Live prices and order progress for the partner portal
description: Signed-in partners follow a product's price on the WebSocket /ws/prices (send {"subscribe": "<sku>"}) and an order's progress on the server-sent events stream GET /events/orders.
acceptanceCriteria: A subscription to P-2 on /ws/prices answers its price 24.99 first, then its availability, and nothing else.
The order stream sends created, paid and shipped, in that order, then ends.
